title: Beyond Frameworks: Unpacking Collaboration Strategies in Multi-Agent Systems

claims.statement: Different configurations of collaboration dimensions significantly influence performance, with an accuracy gap of up to 37.6% across strategies.
claims.quote: leading to an accuracy gap of up to 37.6%

claims.statement: Some collaboration strategies reach similar accuracy but differ substantially in token cost.
claims.quote: there is a substantial variation in token cost

claims.statement: In the EBFC task, strategy G1-P2-I4-C2 reaches accuracy comparable to G2-P3-I1-C3 but produces 11.5 times more output tokens.

title: Beyond Frameworks: Unpacking Collaboration Strategies in Multi-Agent Systems

claims.statement: In the SES scenario, context strategy C2 incurs much higher token costs than C1 and C3, while C3 shows more stable performance.
claims.quote: C2, which overemphasizes an agent's preferred evidence type, costs much higher token costs

claims.statement: LatentMAS reduces token usage by 59.4% to 87.9% compared with TextMAS.
